text: Home: Context, Project, Local and Global, plus your Library.
Context shows every file Claude loads, in order, and why.
Press → for Codex. The first file in each chain is Global.
The Library: your Profiles and the Sections they share.
Profile laptop: each runtime gets the Sections it needs.
Profile hosted: same library, another machine, another mix.
Agent Common is used by every Profile. Edit it once.
Documents render as Markdown. Press m for the raw source.
Your agent edits the Section. The TUI reloads as it works.
One edit: Claude, Codex and Pi are all out of sync.
Review the Global difference before anything is applied.
Authorize Apply. All three targets are current again.
Keep the library in dotfiles. Each machine applies its Profile.
